---
title: "5.1 Cross Reference of Chemical vs. Trade Names of Pesticides"
---

Key to pesticide type: (A) = Acaricide; (B) = Bactericide; (F) = Fungicide; (I)= Insecticide. 

NOTE: See Chapter 8 for a discussion of herbicides used in tree fruit.
